plugins.name: typesafe-jev
plugins.description: Ask for typed judgments with probabilities instead of parsing prose, through TypeSafe or OpenRouter (Jev: noul, choice, score, box) or Ollama (Clef: noul, choice, score). Adds one MCP tool, evaluate, and two skills. The evaluate binary installs separately, and a TypeSafe or OpenRouter key is optional.
